meta.rule: Every colour here was read off a photograph of the real place. `from` names the photograph. Nothing is pasted from a photograph: these are colours and proportions, drawn again.

photos.central-1: 黑河中央街-1-2017.jpg, Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0. Central Street by day: long six-storey blocks in salmon render with cream panels and pilasters, gables on the cornice, a corner tower with a red cone, shop boards along the ground floor, grey stone paving, stone ball bollards.
photos.central-2: 黑河中央街-2-2017.jpg, Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0. The other end of Central Street: a red building with white pilasters, arches and cornices under green domes, a pale grey classical front with a tall arched window, a green bank board with gold letters, a brick chimney, signs in Chinese and Russian.
photos.street-night-1: Streets of Heihe 04.01.2026.jpg, Wikimedia Commons, CC0. A residential street on a January night: yellow walls with crimson balcony bands, white window frames, glazed balconies, blue and purple shop boards, pollarded trees, sodium lamps, thin packed snow on wet asphalt, brick pavement.
photos.street-night-2: Streets of Heihe 04.01.2026 (2).jpg, Wikimedia Commons, CC0. Red brick pavement, white tile and red brick low buildings with roller shutters, salmon blocks with yellow bay bands, dirty snow along the kerb, white cars with blue plates.
photos.goods-street: 黑河市俄罗斯商品街.jpg, Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0. Tan tile blocks with cream bands and glazed balconies, a teal iron arch, globe lamps on black posts, steps up to raised shops.
photos.mother: 黑河市，母亲雕塑2017.jpg, Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0. The Mother sculpture: green bronze on a tall dark red polished granite plinth with green characters; Blagoveshchensk across the river is low, brick-orange and white.
photos.street-night-3: Streets of Heihe 04.01.2026 (3).jpg, Wikimedia Commons, CC0. Ground-floor shops on a winter night: dark green and red quilted winter door curtains, red doorway banners, white air-conditioner units above the boards, whitewashed lower tree trunks.
photos.street-night-4: Streets of Heihe 04.01.2026 (4).jpg, Wikimedia Commons, CC0. Concrete utility poles with black-and-yellow warning stripes and overhead wires, teal and red enclosed motorised three-wheelers on the brick pavement.
photos.pushkin: 普希金书店2017.jpg, Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0. Pushkin bronze statue on a dark red granite plinth in front of the Xinhua / Pushkin bookstore on Central Street, paired red round lamp-post medallions.
photos.memorial: 黑河旅俄华侨纪念馆街景 2025-10-12.jpg, Wikimedia Commons, CC BY 4.0. Rose-red facade with white quoins on Wangsu Street, whitewashed tree trunks with wooden tripod stakes, yellow kerb line on brick pavement.
photos.river-wheel: Blagoveshchensk, Russia --- Heihe, China (8789486307).jpg and Blagoveshchensk, Russia Heihe, China (8799506204).jpg, Wikimedia Commons, CC BY 2.0. The white Ferris wheel and steel lattice tower on the Heihe riverside embankment, and the red-roofed white tourist boat pavilion.
photos.verge-2021: Heihe Beiya Bus Line 3,Shuchi YTK6721GH,黑N81330.jpg, Wikimedia Commons, Rayista Wang, CC BY-SA 4.0. 13 July 2021, bright haze. A bus under the red Heilongjiang bridge approach: mown verge, meadow behind a wire fence, dry road, stone pitching.
photos.riverbank-2017-1: 黑龙江畔眺望大岛-1-2017.jpg, Wikimedia Commons, Amarespeco, CC BY-SA 4.0. 13 August 2017 morning, clear. The Amur at low water from the Heihe bank: gravel bars, boulders, open water reflecting the sky, Blagoveshchensk across.
photos.riverbank-2017-2: 黑龙江畔眺望大岛-2-2017.jpg, Wikimedia Commons, Amarespeco, CC BY-SA 4.0. 13 August 2017 morning, clear. New riverside works in Heihe: concrete wall and apron, gravel strip, dumped earth, lawn and path; Blagoveshchensk embankment and trees across.
photos.wangsu-2017: 王肃公园——烈士纪念碑 2017.jpg, Wikimedia Commons, Amarespeco, CC BY-SA 4.0. 13 August 2017 morning, sun. Wang Su Park: Scots pine, spruce and broadleaf trees, whitewashed trunks, grey brick paving.
photos.wangsu-tomb-2017: 王肃墓2017.jpg, Wikimedia Commons, Amarespeco, CC BY-SA 4.0. 13 August 2017 morning, sun. Wang Su's tomb with granite posts, hedges and a Scots pine trunk.
photos.boat-blag-2017: 客轮远眺布拉戈维申斯克-1-2017.jpg, Wikimedia Commons, Amarespeco, CC BY-SA 4.0. 12 August 2017 afternoon, clear. From the passenger boat: mid-river water, the Blagoveshchensk embankment wall and stepped revetment, red and grey metal roofs.
photos.mosque-2017: Heihe Mosque.jpg, Wikimedia Commons, Antolavoasio, CC BY-SA 4.0. 12 August 2017, low sun. The green log mosque; behind it six-storey white-tile housing blocks with red and blue metal roofs.
photos.promenade-2010: Вид на Благовещенск с набережной Хэйхэ.JPG, Wikimedia Commons, 'Rogis95, CC0. 24 August 2010, 16:24, sun. Heihe riverside promenade: cream parapet panels, stone-clad piers, grey and red pavers, a weeping willow.
photos.quay-2019: 201907 Crossing the Heilong (Amur) from Heihe to Blagoveshchensk 01.jpg, Wikimedia Commons, Jonashtand, CC BY-SA 4.0. 7 July 2019, overcast. Concrete apron of the Heihe passenger port.
photos.crossing-2019-04: 201907 Crossing the Heilong (Amur) from Heihe to Blagoveshchensk 04.jpg, Wikimedia Commons, Jonashtand, CC BY-SA 4.0. 7 July 2019, overcast. Leaving the Heihe pontoon: sand bar under the embankment, grey water.
photos.crossing-2019-07: 201907 Crossing the Heilong (Amur) from Heihe to Blagoveshchensk 07.jpg, Wikimedia Commons, Jonashtand, CC BY-SA 4.0. 7 July 2019, overcast. Mid-river water under a grey sky.
photos.port-2019: 201907 Heihe Port 01.jpg, Wikimedia Commons, Jonashtand, CC BY-SA 4.0. 7 July 2019, overcast. Dry asphalt car park outside the Heihe port building.
photos.station-square-2019: 201907 View from Heihe Railway Station.jpg, Wikimedia Commons, Jonashtand, CC BY-SA 4.0. 20 July 2019, 20:06, overcast. Station square with grey slab paving.
photos.island-shore-2023: Bulagoveshchensk in Heihe.jpg, Wikimedia Commons, Steve Zhang, CC BY-SA 4.0. 30 July 2023, sun. Waterline on Big Heihe Island: wavelets showing the silty water's own colour, shallows over gravel.
photos.friendship-2024: 黑河市友谊宫兼老年大学.jpg, Wikimedia Commons, HCCB3947, CC BY-SA 4.0 (Display P3 file, read as sRGB). 7 September 2024, sun. Friendship Palace forecourt, asphalt in sun and in tree shade.
photos.chamber-2024: 黑河市商会旧址.jpg, Wikimedia Commons, HCCB3947, CC BY-SA 4.0 (Display P3 file, read as sRGB). 7 September 2024, sun. Granite slab plaza before the former Chamber of Commerce.
photos.bridge-park-2024: Heilongjiang bridge Park.jpg, Wikimedia Commons, HCCB3947, CC BY 4.0 (Display P3 file, read as sRGB). 7 September 2024, sun. Mown lawn starting to yellow, tall grass, red surfaced path.
photos.flag-square-2023: 黑龙江省黑河市江畔的五星红旗.jpg, Wikimedia Commons, VentiHEK, CC BY-SA 4.0. 22 October 2023, low sun. Riverside flag square: lawn with yellow tips, dug-over bed, worn earth, pale paving.
photos.station-oct-2024: 正在建设的黑河站新站房（2024.10.13）.jpg, Wikimedia Commons, VentiHEK, CC BY-SA 4.0. 13 October 2024, hazy sun. Station square with street trees in autumn colour.
photos.april-street-2007: Heihe.jpg, Wikimedia Commons, Geoalex, public domain. 11 April 2007, 07:12. Heihe after the melt: no snow, no leaves, dusty pale road, dead hedges and verges.
photos.may-street-2013: Heihe, China (8799033151).jpg, Wikimedia Commons (from Flickr), Sharon Hahn Darlin, CC BY 2.0. 21 May 2013, sun, overexposed. Young street trees in their first leaves.
photos.may-port-2020: River Amur-Heihe.jpg, Wikimedia Commons, Oleg fok, CC BY-SA 4.0. 26 May 2020, sun. Heihe cargo port across the water, warehouse roofs, fresh willow scrub on the near bank.
photos.from-blag-2011: Благовещенск-2011 (104).JPG, Wikimedia Commons, LxAndrew, CC BY-SA 4.0. 9 August 2011, hazy sun. Heihe's riverfront from the Blagoveshchensk side across wide turbid water.
photos.blag-elm-2020: Nature takes its toll. Amur region. Blagoveshchensk 09.2021(Природа берет свое. Амурская область. Благовещенск 09.2021).jpg, Wikimedia Commons, Chursaev13, CC BY 4.0. EXIF 13 August 2020. A Blagoveshchensk street elm: furrowed bark, bare earth in the tree pit.
photos.freeze-up-2023: Views of Blagoveshchensk (November 2023) - 2.jpg, Wikimedia Commons, Vyacheslav Bukharov, CC BY-SA 4.0. 29 November 2023, low sun. The Amur at freeze-up: jammed floes, refrozen leads, young ice.
photos.bridge-freeze-2019: Bridge Blagoveshchensk - Heihe in winter.jpg, Wikimedia Commons, Ministry of the Russian Federation for the Development of the Far East, attribution-only licence. 29 November 2019, low sun. Floes and open water between the bridge piers.
photos.ice-check-2015: Amur River and Heihe.jpg, Wikimedia Commons, Baycrest, CC BY-SA 2.5. Winter 2015. Snow-covered river ice in front of Heihe, seen from Blagoveshchensk.
